How I work, in three steps.

Step 1

Learn it properly.

  • Java and C++.
  • Linux administration.
  • AWS cloud.
  • AI tooling with Claude.

Ten certificates since December 2025, from Anthropic, AWS, Red Hat, Pearson and HackerRank. Studied, tested, then applied.

Step 2

Build real things.

  • React and Next.js.
  • Node.js.
  • Tailwind CSS.
  • SQL.

Full-stack web apps that solve one specific problem, from finding the right AI tool to finding a good cafe nearby.
